title: On the T-Adaptive Segment Routing Problem
summary: In this paper, we present a multi-period optimization problem arising from the traffic engineering of core IP/MPLS networks, called T-ASR. This problem aims at computing a sequence of segment routing paths that adapt to a multi-period scheduled maintenance, while allowing limited number of path reconfigurations between successive time steps.
